name: forex-agent

http.bind: 127.0.0.1 only (loopback; this IS the access control)

tools.name: forex.market_data
tools.description: Recent closed OHLC candles for a symbol/timeframe, oldest first.

tools.name: forex.analyze
tools.description: Deterministic analysis: EMA/RSI/ATR snapshot, SMC structure, strategy evaluation on closed candles. ml_prediction is honestly unavailable until a real model exists.

tools.name: forex.get_signal
tools.description: Full local record for one signal id, including lifecycle status.

tools.name: forex.get_signals
tools.description: Recent signals with derived lifecycle status (detected, approved, rejected, executed, blocked, closed), newest first.

tools.name: forex.get_positions
tools.description: Currently open positions from the broker (ground truth).

tools.name: forex.get_account
tools.description: Broker account snapshot: balance and equity, margin, currency.

tools.name: forex.get_risk
tools.description: Risk picture: kill-switch state, risk engine state, open positions, correlated-exposure flags, and optional dollar-risk math for a hypothetical trade (symbol, direction, lot_size, stop_loss_distance).

tools.name: forex.get_performance
tools.description: Real track record (win rate, profit factor, net P/L) computed from actual broker deal history.

tools.name: forex.get_trade_history
tools.description: Recent trade outcomes from the local event-derived ledger.

tools.name: forex.get_smc
tools.description: Smart Money Concepts structure: trend, BOS, S/R zones, liquidity zones, fair value gaps, order blocks.

tools.name: forex.get_session
tools.description: Currently active forex sessions (Tokyo/London/New York) and the liquidity implication.

tools.name: forex.get_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming high-impact economic events, if a calendar source is configured. Returns available:false honestly otherwise - never invents events.

tools.name: forex.get_experience
tools.description: Past self-reflections on a symbol: what was reasoned beforehand vs what actually happened, including documented mistakes.

tools.name: forex.get_health
tools.description: Structured health of every subsystem component: broker, kill switch, event bus, Worker reachability, daemons.

tools.name: forex.request_trade
tools.description: Request a trade via the Execution Gateway (risk checks, kill switch, dry-run block enforced; audit-logged). Returns the gateway verdict - never reports execution before broker confirmation. stop_loss is mandatory.

tools.name: forex.close_position
tools.description: Close an open position by ticket. CURRENTLY UNAVAILABLE: core.execution.gateway exposes no close API yet; returns DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE rather than bypassing the gateway.

tools.name: forex.modify_position
tools.description: Modify SL/TP on an open position. CURRENTLY UNAVAILABLE: core.execution.gateway exposes no modify API yet; returns DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE rather than bypassing the gateway.

tools.name: forex.kill_switch
tools.description: Engage (default) or clear the kill switch. Engaging latches locally below the agent layer: the gateway blocks all new entries immediately.

daemons.name: signal_monitor
daemons.description: Deterministic EMA/RSI signal detection; publishes signal.detected. Never trades.

daemons.name: position_monitor
daemons.description: Exit-manager pass over the bot's own positions (breakeven/trailing/time stops).

daemons.name: health_monitor
daemons.description: Fail-closed kill-switch poll (10s), Worker sync, 6h performance sync.

safety_invariants: Dry-run by default; live trading cannot be casually enabled.
Trade-affecting tools route only through core.execution.gateway.
Kill switch is fail-closed and checked before every trade.
Worker (cloud) outage never disables local safety.
No market data is ever invented; disconnected broker => honest errors.
Local API binds only to 127.0.0.1; no secrets in logs or events.
